1951, January 29
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
ST. FELIX FRIARY ROUTE 8 HUNTINGTON, INDIANA
January 29 1951
Blessed be God. In all His designs.
Mrs. Raymond Schick Monroe Michigan
God bless you Mrs. Schick.
I hope you are well and that by this time things have brightened in regard to your little Mary. I put your letter aside - having noted your favor, for which many thanks, a special Mass at the time - and then lost track of it. I wanted to answer it personally. I surely sympathize with you and your family. We have had quite a few cases similar to little Mary's, the majority of which, thanks be to God, have come through astonishingly well. They sometimes seem miraculous. Glory be to God.
Febr. 2 - Feast of Purification
ST. FELIX FRIARY ROUTE 8 HUNTINGTON, INDIANA
Blessed be God in all His designs.
